Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) study using the BS3 crosslinker. While the search parameters mention 'DSS' as the link search type, the methods explicitly state the use of BS3. This maps to a cross-linking workflow (mod_tpp in the provided modifier list is the closest proxy for structural proteomics/cross-linking if a specific XL modifier isn't listed, though typically XL-MS is its own category).

scope: The anti-FLAG M2 Affinity Gel (Sigma) was used for affinity isolation of FLAG-tagged Rix1 complex members and reconstituted complexes.
Purified complex (6.0 μM for PELP1 Rix1 domain – WDR18 sub-complex and 2.0 μM for Rix1 complex) was crosslinked with 1.0 mM and 1.2 mM, respectively, of bis(sulfosuccinimidyl)suberate (BS3)
The Rix1 complex was purified via the C-terminal FLAG tag on full length PELP1 and then concentrated prior to crosslinking.
The complex was purified via the N-terminal FLAG-tagged PELP1 Rix1 domain.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on purified Rix1 complexes and PELP1-WDR18 sub-complexes isolated via anti-FLAG affinity purification.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics component of this study is a structural characterization using chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) to map protein-protein interactions within the Rix1 complex. This is a descriptive structural study rather than a differential expression or perturbation study. While the authors performed other differential assays (luciferase, co-IP), those are not the focus of the MS dataset. The only 'comparison' in the MS data is the presence vs. absence of the crosslinker (BS3) to validate crosslink identification.
